latest_release.body:
# Moonfin 3.1.0 Release Notes [![github](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/3.1.0/total?logo=github&label=Downloads)](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases/tag/3.1.0)

## Features

### Servers
- Moonfin works with Silo servers. Sign in with a password, or with a code on TV, pick a household profile, then browse, play, download and request titles through Silo's own requests.
- Moonbase now runs on Plex as a companion service next to Plex Media Server. It brings settings sync, ratings and reviews, custom rows, similar items, anime markers, retro games, Seerr, Smart Search, the seasonal row and the calendar to Plex. If it isn't on port 32500, set its address under Settings > Account > Settings Sync > Moonbase Address. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*

### Watch Parties
- Watch Parties come to Jellyfin, Emby and Plex, with a room list, a Home row, invite links and codes, chat, reactions, voting on what to watch and synced playback. Turn them on under Settings > Playback > Watch Parties. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- On Silo, Watch Parties use Silo's own rooms. On Jellyfin you can still start SyncPlay groups, and the SyncPlay screen has a new look with everyone's profile picture.

### Home
- A new Watching on MDBList row shows what MDBList users are watching right now. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- The media bar labels series with New Series, New Season or New Episodes, and has a new New Seasons & Episodes source.
- IMDb, TMDB and custom list rows show your server's own poster and progress for titles you already have.
- IMDb, TMDB and seasonal rows no longer need their own switches. They show up in the Home Rows editor whenever the server can fill them.
- Row Options has a Hide Watched switch for the Recently Added and Recently Released rows, and it follows your server's own setting. (#2210)
- The Radarr and Sonarr upcoming rows hide titles already on your server, and dates read Today, Tomorrow or In 3 days.
- Each library's Latest row and every pinned collection row ends with a See All card. (#1928)
- Admins can add poster labels like 4K, HDR or Atmos in Moonbase. You can turn them off with Poster Labels under Settings > Appearance. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- Hide Watch Progress and Hide Unwatched Count under Settings > Appearance > Home Screen hide the progress bar and the unwatched badge on Home posters.
- The seasonal row's Show All Year setting shows a holiday row outside the holiday dates too.
- The media bar backdrop fades out at the bottom on desktop and web. (#2095)

### Details
- There are four new details styles, Stage, Premiere, Quick Look and Frost, under Settings > Appearance > Details Page > Details Screen Style.
- The long-press menu has Remove from Playlist and Remove from Collection for items that are in one.
- Season and episode rows have scroll arrows on desktop.

### Search and Seerr
- Smart Search lets you search by describing what you want in a sentence, once your admin turns it on in Moonbase. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- Search has an Audiobooks row, and Discover has a Search button that opens on the Requests results.
- Favorites has a Watchlist tab for your Seerr watchlist.
- Seerr requests show why a download is stuck, and admins can grab a different release. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- Seerr's status on posters can show as a corner dot or a banner, with the new Badge Style setting.
- Seerr Discover posters follow your poster size, and Sort & Filter has a Movies or TV Shows switch.
- When an admin renames Seerr in Moonbase, Moonfin uses that name everywhere.

### Calendar
- A new Calendar screen shows upcoming and recently aired episodes and movies from Sonarr and Radarr, in Agenda or Countdown style with a full month view. Turn on Show Calendar Button to add it to the navigation bar. On phones, Remind me sends a notification when a title reaches your library. *(Needs Moonbase 3.1.0)*
- The upcoming rows can end with a See All card
